# Cambridge Intelligence

> Cambridge Intelligence provides high-performance graph, timeline, and geospatial visualization SDKs for JavaScript and React developers to analyze connected data in cybersecurity, fraud detection, and intelligence applications.

Cambridge Intelligence specializes in data visualization technology for threat detection and intelligence analysis. Their suite of SDKs—KeyLines, ReGraph, KronoGraph, and MapWeave—enable developers to build interactive visualization tools for security operations, fraud analysis, and law enforcement investigations.

## Key Topics

- Graph visualization
- Timeline visualization
- Geospatial visualization
- JavaScript SDK
- React SDK
- GPU rendering
- Cybersecurity
- Fraud detection
- Network analysis
- Link analysis
- Connected data
- Intelligence analysis
- KeyLines
- ReGraph
- KronoGraph

## Visualization SDKs

- [KeyLines - The Graph Visualization SDK for JavaScript Developers](https://cambridge-intelligence.com/keylines): KeyLines graph visualization SDK for JavaScript developers with GPU rendering.
- [ReGraph | Graph Visualization Software For React Developers](https://cambridge-intelligence.com/regraph): ReGraph toolkit for React developers with high-performance graph visualization.
- [KronoGraph - Advanced Timeline Visualization That Scales](https://cambridge-intelligence.com/kronograph): KronoGraph timeline visualization SDK for interactive time-based connected data.
- [MapWeave - The Geospatial Visualization SDK that uncovers every connection](https://cambridge-intelligence.com/mapweave): MapWeave geospatial visualization SDK with Mapbox/MapLibre integration.
